description: Excavate every cyan core from the ore racks. Mine teal-seamed stone, preserve gold striped supports, and exit with all ore. EXIT is a final submission. A broken support or rejected EXIT ends the episode. Missed picks and view changes remain allowed. Use only the visible task UI.
